summary: uri options: force_basic_auth (send credentials upfront), group, custom headers dict (can override Content-Type), and http_agent.
questions: Why does my API return 401 even though I gave credentials?
How do I add an Authorization or custom header?

answer_card.title: uri auth and headers
answer_card.answer_md:
- `force_basic_auth` (false): send Basic auth on the first request. Use when the API always needs auth, doesn't send 401 properly, or rate-limits 401s.
- `headers`: dict; overrides generated `Content-Type`
- `http_agent` (`ansible-httpget`), `group`
